reviews.body:
## Code Review

This pull request significantly improves the 'Evaluate DB' form by refactoring the frontend to use Material-UI components for a more consistent and modern UI. It also introduces new backend endpoints to dynamically fetch form options like teams and formats, replacing hardcoded values. The changes are well-executed. I've added a few suggestions to further improve the user experience on the form and to reduce some code duplication in the new backend database queries.

## Code Review

This pull request introduces significant improvements to the "Evaluate DB" feature. On the frontend, the UI has been completely revamped using Material-UI components, resulting in a much cleaner and more modern user experience. This includes fetching form options dynamically from the backend. On the backend, new Go endpoints and database queries have been added to support this, complete with unit tests. The `Makefile` has also been improved with a safer `dev-down` and a new `dev-destroy` command. Overall, this is a high-quality contribution. I have a few suggestions to improve error handling in the frontend and fix a small issue in the backend tests.

## Code Review

This pull request introduces significant improvements to the "Evaluate DB" feature, primarily by refactoring the frontend components to use Material-UI. This results in a much cleaner, more modern, and more maintainable user interface. The backend is extended with new API endpoints to provide dynamic options (teams, formats) for the form, backed by new database queries. The changes are well-implemented, including proper testing for the new backend logic and updates to the frontend tests to match the new UI components.

I have a couple of minor suggestions to further refine the code. One is a small improvement in the frontend event handling to avoid redundant function calls, and the other is to enhance the test mocks in the backend to cover an error-handling path.

Overall, this is an excellent pull request that greatly enhances the quality of the feature.

## Code Review

This pull request significantly improves the 'Evaluate DB' tab by refactoring the UI to use Material-UI components, resulting in a much cleaner and more modern user experience. The form for selecting matches is now more dynamic, fetching team and format options from new backend APIs instead of using hardcoded values. The backend is extended with new handlers and database queries to support this, complete with thorough tests.

The introduction of `dev-destroy` in the Makefile is a thoughtful change that clarifies the behavior of tearing down the development environment. Additionally, the Go database layer was improved by adding the `Err()` method to the `Rows` interface, which is a good practice for robust error handling.

Overall, this is a high-quality contribution that enhances both the frontend and backend. I've added one suggestion to reduce code duplication in the `EvaluationResults` component for future maintainability.

## Code Review

This pull request significantly improves the "Evaluate DB" feature. The frontend is refactored to use Material-UI, resulting in a much cleaner, more modern, and maintainable UI. The backend is extended with new endpoints to dynamically populate form options, complete with robust database logic and tests. The introduction of a less destructive `make dev-down` command is also a welcome improvement for local development. Overall, this is an excellent set of changes. I have one minor suggestion for a documentation file.

## Code Review

This pull request introduces significant improvements across the board. The pre-commit hook has been optimized to run checks only on staged files, which is a major performance win. The frontend's "Evaluate DB" tab has been completely revamped using Material-UI and `react-router-dom`, resulting in a much better user experience and more maintainable code. The backend has been enhanced with new paginated endpoints, API options for form data, and improved database observability features. Overall, these are excellent changes that enhance developer experience, application performance, and UI quality. I've left a few suggestions for further refinement, mainly around code duplication and script robustness.

## Code Review

This pull request introduces a wide range of significant improvements, including refactoring the `pre-commit` hook for efficiency, overhauling the frontend with `react-router-dom` for navigation and Material-UI for forms, and adding new backend API endpoints for fetching form options and paginating migration history. The backend also benefits from better dependency management in Go services and more robust database queries. However, two critical security vulnerabilities were identified: a potential SQL injection in the database statistics retrieval logic and a resource exhaustion vulnerability in the `paginated migrations list` endpoint. These security issues must be addressed to ensure the robustness and security of the application, alongside a couple of minor suggestions for further refinement.

## Code Review

This pull request delivers a significant set of improvements, centered around enhancing the 'Evaluate DB' form but also touching many other parts of the system. The pre-commit hook has been completely rewritten for efficiency, now only checking staged files. On the frontend, the application has been refactored to use `react-router-dom` for navigation, and the UI components for evaluation and operational status have been upgraded to Material-UI, providing a much-improved user experience. The backend has been updated to support these changes with new API endpoints for form options, paginated responses for migrations, and more detailed database statistics. I've identified a few areas for minor improvement, such as simplifying the pre-commit script and optimizing a database query pattern. Overall, this is an excellent and comprehensive update.

## Code Review

This pull request introduces significant improvements across the frontend and backend. The frontend `EvaluateDbTab` is completely refactored to use Material-UI components and `react-router-dom` for navigation, greatly enhancing the user experience and code quality. The pre-commit hook has been optimized to run formatters and linters only on staged files, which will speed up local development workflows. On the backend, several new endpoints have been added to support the frontend changes, including paginated migrations and options for teams and formats. The database queries have been made more robust, and a repository pattern has been introduced for data exports.

## Code Review

This pull request refactors the frontend's 'Evaluate DB' tab using MUI components and `react-router`, and enhances backend services by adding new endpoints, implementing pagination for migrations, and improving the `pre-commit hook`. However, two high-severity security vulnerabilities were identified: a command injection flaw in the `pre-commit hook` and a potential indirect prompt injection vulnerability in the newly added AI skill, both of which could lead to arbitrary code execution. Additionally, there are suggestions to improve the robustness of the new `pre-commit script` and add clarity to a new database query function.

## Code Review

The pull request includes changes to the pre-commit hook to optimize checks on modified files for Go, Python, and Frontend projects, including formatting, linting, and staging changes. It also adds a check for partially staged files. Additionally, the Makefile was updated to include a `dev-destroy` target, and the frontend was updated to use react-router-dom for navigation. The context provider was updated to fix dynamic ignores. The review comments suggest using proper identifier escaping to prevent SQL injection vulnerabilities and consolidating Python linting and checking steps to use `ruff` instead of both `ruff` and `flake8`.

## Code Review

This pull request refactors the frontend UI with Material-UI components, implements `react-router-dom` for routing, updates the backend with new API endpoints for options and pagination for migrations, and improves the pre-commit hook for efficiency. A high-severity SQL injection vulnerability was identified in the `GetTableStats` function due to unsafe SQL query construction using database identifiers. While other changes, including frontend and new pagination logic, follow security best practices, further attention is needed to enhance the robustness and maintainability of the new pre-commit hook.

## Code Review

This pull request significantly improves the UI, developer experience, and performance by optimizing the `pre-commit` hook, overhauling the frontend with `react-router-dom` and Material-UI for `EvaluateDbTab`, and extending the backend with new API endpoints for form options and paginated data.
